_: THE FULL-UNCHANGED SELF-TEST'S PLANTS (queue 980; DESIGN.md §0.4.5 'The gate, structurally'; the 1 Oct review). Changes Full must never get. tools/full-unchanged.sh plants each one in a COPY of the tree on every run, measures it with the groups and widths named here, and refuses PASS unless each turns the comparison red FOR ITS OWN REASON: a difference line that starts with the width and carries every string in `sig` — sig[0] says WHERE (a screen, a step, a key) and every later string must be in WHAT the line says differs (after the step's name), so a step whose name happens to contain a word cannot catch anything by its name (6 Oct: 'Bounce on a camera … frames on the ring' matched sig ['Bounce on a camera', 'frames'] on a jitter line while the planted decay drew nothing). A red that names something else is luck, not a catch — and so is a signature broad enough to be met by another change's lines (6 Oct: with the review's nineteen replayed as ONE release, 'state.doc' and 'key.state' were met by the colour plant's clipColor lines), so each names the field its own change moves. DESIGN's three (a picture margin, a toast word, the split floor) and EVERY change the 1 Oct review slipped past v1 (its blocker's nineteen: P1 overlay, P12 icon, P3 hover, P4 sheetmotion, P13 cropbar, V1 halfres, P5 shift34, Q2 key, Q3 addtab, P6 touch, P10 group, P11 uiroute, T1 speedtoast, P7 colour, P8 export, P9 bounce, R1 manifest, S1 sanitiser, E1 endnudge), DESIGN's B4 and B5 guards (matte, follow, seam), which v1 had no step for; and the review's Q1 (zoomstep: finding 4 found the timeline zoom unrecorded, so a changed zoom step was red only by accident). And (6 Oct, the second review) ALL SIXTEEN changes it slipped past v2 in one 'Simple release' — w440 his phone's own rule, h720 a short screen's, friendtoast a friend's edit arriving, savefield and indexfield the stored record and the Home card, reduce the reduced-motion path, darkhome a non-default Setting's look, toastpos and marktoast the toast, cogflight an animation started from script, cathover a pseudo-element's hover, ctxhover a menu item's hover, scrubrate an un-held finger, audiobr the exported sound, brightdef an effect's default, keyf2 an e.key shortcut — and hold500, the clip hold it found the probe held past; one plant in every run tools/full-unchanged.sh FU_RUNS adds (tiny320, sideways, band1226, widepc, detail), so each run's PASS shows that run still sees; and pixels, a change only the pictures can see. `widths` are FU_RUNS labels ('380', '440x956', 'env-1280' …). `groups` is always a PREFIX of the probe's order (FU1, FU2, FU3, FU6, FU4, FU5, FU7), so a plant's run reaches its group exactly as the full run did. `old` must appear EXACTLY once in `file` (tests.js '980 FU lock: every self-test plant still lands exactly once' checks it, so a plant cannot rot silently); `append` adds to the end instead.
